description:
Super Host & Entire Home and Gated Parking for 6 cars.  Our guests  will have access to a complete spacious kitchen, 2 Full Baths(Showers), 2 King bedrooms and 2 Queen Bedrooms & Living room space w/ 2 full size twin trundle beds if needed.  All our rooms are very large!  Enjoy our pickle ball court w/paddles, nets and balls incl.  Relax on our front porch with morning coffee or pre-gaming before walking to Bway (or $6 Uber ride). Well behaved small pets allowed for an addl fee. See details

The space
1929 Historic Home with Huge bedrooms and a front porch for sipping and relaxing!  Very close to downtown Broadway...so you can walk or $6 Uber ride.  Protect your vehicles with our Gated Parking as well at no extra cost. Big enough for 6 vehicles.  No more parking on the street!

Within the gated back area we have a fire pit and chairs for you use. We offer Duraflame logs for an extra $12.00 per log should you wish to use. They are in the white crate on back porch.

Guest access
Entire Home is yours during the stay as well as the gated parking! and Includes 2 full bathrooms with showers.

Within the gated back area we have a fire pit and chairs for you use. We offer Duraflame logs for an extra $12.00 per log should you wish to use. They are in the white crate on back porch.

Other things to note
Small well behaved dogs are allowed for a fee.  Please discuss with us before arrival.
